name: security-audit
description: Security assessment reports with vulnerability analysis, risk evaluation, and remediation recommendations
purpose: Document security assessments with detailed findings, risk analysis, and actionable remediation steps

format.structure: Executive Summary > Scope > Methodology > Findings > Risk Assessment > Recommendations > Remediation Plan
